title: List entry after dropping a prefix
statement: Let $x$ and $r$ be Boolean lists, let $p$ be a natural number, and let $b$ be a Boolean. If dropping the first $p$ entries of $x$ yields the list whose first entry is $b$ and whose remaining entries form $r$, then the entry of $x$ at index $p$, using false as the default for an out-of-range index, is $b$.
hypotheses_covered: Dropping the first $p$ entries of $x$ yields $b$ followed by $r$
